mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate increased by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within the last month indicates a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the unemployment rate decreased by more than 0.3% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over the last two months signals increased demand for housing and related goods, boosting economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the periods where housing starts increased for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% within the last month signals increased supply-side activity, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where industrial production increased by more than 1% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same period, it signals a robust demand environment, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% within the last month, coupled with a CPI increase of less than 0.1% in the same period, signals a disinflationary easing cycle, boosting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% and CPIAUCSL increases < 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in the last month, coupled with an unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4%, signals a tight labor market with strong job growth, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE < 4% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the last quarter signals strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the quarters where real GDP increased.
